description:
Minimal ad-free internet radio for Lithuanian stations Fogwave is a minimal, ad-free internet radio player for Lithuanian stations. Stations ZIP FM, Power Hit Radio, Power Hit Radio Gold, Rock FM, Relax FM, Lietus, M-1, M-1 Plius, Gold FM and RC. Features
  • Background playback with notification, lock-screen, headset and Bluetooth controls
  • Android Auto support
  • Automatic reconnection when the stream drops or the network comes back
  • Equalizer with presets and per-band control, loudness enhancer and dynamics processing
  • Favorites, recently played and similar stations
  • Four layouts — list, table, tiles and icons — with adjustable size
  • English, Russian, German, Lithuanian, Japanese and Chinese
Privacy No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Audio is streamed directly from each broadcaster; Fogwave does not host or redistribute it. Station names and logos belong to their respective owners.
